1. Limitation of Liability
The Provider's liability under this Agreement shall be unlimited and shall not be limited in any way.

1. Limitation of Liability
Each party's aggregate liability shall not exceed the fees paid in the twelve (12) months preceding the claim.

1. Limitation of Liability
Each party's aggregate liability shall not exceed the fees paid in the three (3) months preceding the claim.

1. Limitation of Liability
Each party's aggregate liability shall not exceed $2,000,000 in total.

1. Limitation of Liability
The liability of the parties shall be limited in accordance with applicable law.

1. Indemnification
Each party shall indemnify the other against third-party claims arising from its own breach.

1. Indemnification
The Provider shall indemnify the Customer against all claims and losses arising under this Agreement.

1. Indemnification
The Provider shall indemnify the Customer against all claims, including claims arising from the Customer's own negligence.

1. Intellectual Property
The Provider hereby assigns to the Customer all right, title and interest in all intellectual property, including the Provider's pre-existing intellectual property and background IP.

1. Intellectual Property
The Provider hereby assigns to the Customer all intellectual property in the Deliverables created under this Agreement.

1. Intellectual Property
The Provider retains ownership of all intellectual property in its tools and methods; no assignment is made.

1. Confidentiality
Each party shall hold the other's Confidential Information in confidence for three (3) years.

1. Confidentiality
The Receiving Party shall not disclose the Disclosing Party's Confidential Information for three (3) years.

1. Confidentiality
The Receiving Party shall keep the Disclosing Party's Confidential Information confidential in perpetuity.

1. Term and Termination
Either party may terminate this Agreement for convenience on thirty (30) days' written notice.

1. Term and Renewal
This Agreement renews automatically for successive terms unless a party gives notice of non-renewal at least one hundred twenty (120) days before the term ends. Either party may terminate for convenience on written notice.

1. Term
This Agreement continues for successive one-year terms and may not be terminated during any term.

1. Fees and Payment
Invoices are payable Net 30 from the invoice date.

1. Fees and Payment
Invoices are payable Net 60 from the invoice date.

1. Fees and Payment
Invoices are payable Net 90 from the invoice date.

1. Governing Law
This Agreement is governed by the laws of the State of Delaware.

1. Governing Law
This Agreement is governed by the laws of the State of California.

1. Governing Law
This Agreement is governed by the laws of England and Wales.

1. Data Protection
Personal data shall be processed under the Data Processing Addendum between the parties. Breaches shall be notified within 48 hours.

1. Data Protection
Each party shall maintain appropriate security measures when processing personal data.

1. Data Protection
The parties shall comply with applicable privacy laws when handling personal data.

1. Warranty
The Provider warrants the Services will conform to the specification for 24 months after delivery.

1. Assignment
Neither party may assign this Agreement without the prior written consent of the other.

1. Assignment
A party may assign this Agreement to its affiliates without notice.

1. Entire Agreement
This document is the entire agreement between the parties and supersedes all prior discussions.

1. Sub-processors
The Processor shall give the Controller at least thirty (30) days' prior written notice of any new sub-processor, and the Controller may object within thirty (30) days of that notice.

1. Sub-processors
The Processor may engage or replace sub-processors at its sole discretion and without prior notice to the Controller.

1. International Transfers
The Processor shall not transfer personal data to a third country except under the European Commission's standard contractual clauses.

1. International Transfers
The Processor may transfer personal data to any country where it operates, as it sees fit to do so.

1. Audit Rights
The Controller may audit the Processor's records and systems relevant to the processing on thirty (30) days' written notice, no more than once per year.

1. Audit
The Controller shall have no right to audit the Processor and may not inspect its records.

1. Return and Deletion
On termination of this Addendum, the Processor shall, at the Controller's choice, return or securely delete all personal data and certify the deletion in writing.

1. Deletion and Retention
The Processor shall delete operational copies on termination but may retain all personal data indefinitely in its archives.

1. Restrictive Covenants
For twelve (12) months following the end of employment, the Employee shall not be employed by a business that competes with the Company within the state in which the Employee was employed.

1. Restrictive Covenants
For thirty-six (36) months following the end of employment, the Employee shall not engage in any business, in any capacity, anywhere in the world.

1. Invention Assignment
The Employee hereby assigns to the Company all inventions conceived or reduced to practice in the course of the Employee's employment and relating to the Company's business. Inventions conceived before the employment are excluded from this assignment.

1. Invention Assignment
The Employee hereby assigns to the Company all inventions, whether conceived before or during the employment, including every invention the Employee has conceived at any time.

1. Dispute Resolution
Any dispute arising out of the Employee's employment shall be resolved by binding arbitration, at either party's election. Nothing in this section prevents either party from seeking injunctive relief in court, or from pursuing statutory claims that cannot lawfully be submitted to arbitration.

1. Dispute Resolution
The Employee agrees to arbitrate every dispute arising out of the employment, and all claims shall be resolved exclusively by binding arbitration in an individual capacity only. This section is a class action waiver and a jury trial waiver: the Employee waives any right to bring or participate in a class action or collective action, and waives trial by jury. The Company may pursue any claim against the Employee in any court of competent jurisdiction.

1. Employment Status
The Employee's employment is at will: this is at-will employment, and the employment may be terminated by either party at any time, with or without cause or notice.

1. Employment Status
The Employee shall be employed for a term of three (3) years, and the Employee's employment may be terminated only for cause as narrowly defined in this letter.
